explanation: Merges main (#101) into the HypoMap study-card branch. From main: data/expression/visium/README.md documents the HYPOMAP human Visium reference (pinned RDS, four donor x region tables, derivation, sparse-region and compartment rules, the R 4.6.0 re-extraction and CC BY 4.0 attribution). From this branch: the HypoMap runbook lists which study-card columns the By dataset view shows and the two its CSV adds; the study card, exporter and export format are unchanged.
